name: kavitha
description: A publishing theme for writers and builders.

show_rss_link.description: Show the rss link in the footer. Off hides the link; /rss/ still works for feed readers.

accent_preset.description: Default accent color (Teal or Terracotta). Visitors can override via the footer swatch toggle.

members_cta_body.default: Get new writing in your inbox. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.

show_hero_card.description: Wrap the homepage hero (name + bio) in a teal accent card. Off = plain terminal text.

hero_title.description: Override the hero title on the home page (instead of site title). Empty falls back to site title.

now_text.description: Status sidebar — what you're working on now (e.g. 'Building Claveflux'). Empty hides the sidebar.

based_text.description: Status sidebar — where you're based (e.g. 'Bay Area'). Empty to hide row.

experience_section_title.description: Heading shown on the /experience/ collection page (the work-experience timeline).

show_search.description: Show the search button in the header. Off hides it entirely.

show_signup.description: Show the Subscribe call-to-action under each post and on the homepage. Off hides it everywhere.

show_theme_credit.description: Show 'built with kavitha' credit in footer.

scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -f dist/kavitha.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/kavitha.zip . -x 'node_modules/*' 'src/*' '.git/*' 'screenshots/*' '.github/*' 'dist/*' '*.md' 'package-lock.json' 'build.mjs' 'scripts/*'
